name: Essence of Nightlash
summary: At the Dead Fields, Nightlash's defeat leaves a trace the Forsaken can carry away. High Executor Hadrec needs it as proof that the Scourge force behind the rot hide gnolls has been broken.

sections.title: The Banshee of the Dead Fields
sections.body:
At the abandoned farmstead called the Dead Fields in northern Silverpine, packs of undead rot hide gnolls hold their ground under Scourge command. Forsaken assaults have failed again and again. The feral gnolls are not the cause; their spectral commander, Nightlash, turns the attackers back.

Her wailing magic strengthens the gnoll lines and routs forces sent from the Sepulcher. When Nightlash is slain, her incorporeal form dissolves into dust, leaving a crystalline magical essence behind.

sections.title: Proof of Scourge Defeat
sections.body: Banshees leave no bodily corpse, so Nightlash's essence is the only physical proof that the spirit has been destroyed. High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher needs it to confirm that the Scourge foothold has fallen. With that proof, the Forsaken can secure their northern perimeter and suppress the rot hide threat.

faq.q: What is the Essence of Nightlash?
faq.answer: Nightlash's defeat leaves crystalline dust behind. Since spirits have no physical bodies, the residue proves the Scourge banshee has been destroyed.
At the Dead Fields in northern Silverpine, Nightlash commands and strengthens the rot hide gnolls for the Scourge.
High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher wants the essence as proof that Nightlash has been defeated. She routed his frontline assaults.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls working with a banshee?
faq.answer: The rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields have succumbed to the undead plague and become Scourge thralls. Nightlash was sent to oversee them and lend magical support against Forsaken patrols.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know why destroying banshees like Nightlash matters. Once victims of Scourge domination, the Forsaken fight the Lich King's agents to secure Lordaeron for their own people.
As a mage, you may study the residue left by destroyed banshees to learn how spectral undead bind necrotic magic to the physical world.
